title: fsl_deface
description: Tool to deface a structural T1w image.

cropped_defacing_flag.description: Apply the defacing to the cropped image instead of the original image
cropped_defacing_flag.title: Cropped defacing flag

defacing_mask.description: Filename to save the defacing mask
defacing_mask.title: Defacing mask

cropped_struc.description: Filename to save the new cropped struct
cropped_struc.title: Cropped struct

orig_to_std_mat.description: Filename to save affine matrix from original struct to std
orig_to_std_mat.title: Original to std matrix

orig_to_cropped_mat.description: Filename to save affine matrix from original struct to cropped struct
orig_to_cropped_mat.title: Original to cropped matrix

cropped_to_std_mat.description: Filename to save affine matrix from cropped struct to std
cropped_to_std_mat.title: Cropped to std matrix

shift_nud.description: Shift, in mm, x-, y- and z-directions, to shift face mask by (These matrices will only work if the input has been previously reoriented to std)
shift_nud.title: Face mask shift vector

qc_images.description: Generate 2 pngs to show how the defacing worked for QC purposes
qc_images.title: QC images base name
